semantics.federal_unitid: The entity’s OWN six-digit IPEDS UNITID, or NULL. Never synthetic, never an NCES/College Navigator location code (15111102, 14570703), never a guess. UNIQUE across entities.
semantics.parent_unitid: IPEDS UNITID of the federal institution a campus/branch entity is reported under; the only sanctioned way two entities share a UNITID; set only when proven.
semantics.athletics_entity_id: Internal, stable, opaque id of the athletics institution/campus that recruits (AE-U<unitid> for a single institution; AE-X-<slug> for a modeled exception). Never copied into a federal UNITID field.
semantics.programme_identity: athletics_entity_id + sport, materialised as one active colleges row whose colleges.id is the programme id.
semantics.campus_label: Human-readable campus disambiguator; required for campus/branch entities.
semantics.colleges_unitid: Legacy federal UNITID for the programme’s institution; unchanged by the entity layer; must agree with its entity (federal or parent) or be NULL.
